# Loading in DeepSeek

DeepSeek has no skill mechanism, so it takes the self-contained single-file core:

1. Open [`prompts/lumi-style-core.md`](../prompts/lumi-style-core.md) and copy it in full;
2. put the core prompt in messages[0] (role=system); re-inject at the start of each long session;
3. Then issue tasks normally ("Following the rules above, write…").

The core is self-contained with zero tool assumptions; on any conflict, `references/` wins. Re-copy it after a rule update — it is a snapshot, and this one is 0.1.518.

For long tasks, re-inject at the start of each new session so the rules are not pushed out of context.

**Capability tier not exercised.** This note claims the `prompt` tier. Not exercised. A prompt-tier claim is that the model gets one pasted file and no tools, which is a claim about what it is NOT given and cannot be confirmed by running anything. It is confirmed by how the package is delivered, not by the agent's behaviour.
